content: Jesu adi wain mebi
“Nu adi bem wain diniŋ mebi hinek kaŋ Baŋ adi dinina wendiniŋ molom.
Ala taŋeniŋne dendi folooŋ mu tiiŋ u yadi Me Baŋdi fidoko moŋgoyakut tilak. Tiŋa folooŋ tiiŋ u dobututumbaune folooŋ wapum mintadok kwanaiŋiŋ tilak.
Hidi mede hanimbe nadiŋit wendi agaŋ hehitubu-walandalak.

Ale hidi nukut kadiŋa hatibune nu maaŋ hidut kadiŋa hatiluwaat. Wain taŋeniŋ niŋ adi mebi gineŋ mu youdihilak adi folooŋ tuwot mu tilak, eŋ mebi gineŋ youdihilak adi folooŋ kedem tilak. Undugoŋ hinek hidi maaŋ nukut mu kadineeŋ uyadi folooŋhinit mokit tineeŋ.

“Nu adi wain mebi hinek kaŋ hidi adi taŋeniŋneye. Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi nu mokit hatiŋa nemek niŋ tineŋdok tuwot mu hatak. Eŋ nebek niŋdi nu’walaŋkade kadiŋa hatilak kaŋ nu maaŋ adut kadiŋa hatilat adi folooŋ wapum tubumintalak.
Nebek niŋ nukut mu kadiŋa hatilak adi indiniŋ: wain taŋeniŋ dobune sigene tiiŋ u moŋgo bopneeŋ wooŋ kudup gineŋ heu dalak. Undugoŋ hinek timindok.
Hidi nukut kadiŋa nu’walaŋ medene kame hatiŋa nemek niŋdok ninadiune wondok tuwot Baŋdi hamuluwaak.
“Hidi folooŋ wapumhinit tiŋa mihineye hinek mintadakaleeŋ hatibu Batne’walaŋ wougigitŋiŋ mintawaak.
Baŋ adi weleŋdi hinek nabukahilelak undugoŋ nu maaŋ welenedi hinek habukahilelat, ale hidi nu’walaŋ welesiloŋ gineŋ uŋgoŋ hatiyaneeŋ.
Nu Baŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ nadiŋa keleeŋ adi’walaŋ welesiloŋŋiŋ gineŋ hatilat undugoŋ hinek hidi maaŋ nu’walaŋ medene keleeŋ hatineeŋ adi nu’walaŋ welesiloŋne gineŋ hatineeŋ.
“Nu’walaŋ welenadifodi hidi’walaŋ welehik gineŋ fotokooŋ hahatdok nadiŋa mede i hanilat. Tiŋa nadifo hidi’walaŋ hatak wendi tuwot kilidapmaaŋ hatuwaak.
Nu yofafaŋe medene niŋ indiŋ hanilat. Nu hiditok welesiloŋ tihamulat undugoŋ hidi hidegoŋ welesiloŋ titiŋ tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.
Nebek niŋdi noliŋiye yehitubu-lodadok nadiŋa kumulak wendi welesiloŋ noli hogohogok u yalakapmedapmalak.
Tiŋa nu kwanai hanilat i tineeŋ wondok hidi nu notneye hatineeŋ.

Nu kotigoŋ hidi tipilapilaye mihineye mu hanilat. Tipilapilaye me adi me wapumŋiŋ’walaŋ weleŋ maaneŋ mede hatak u mu nadilak iŋgoŋ nu adi Batnedi’walaaniŋ mede nadigut hogohogok u agaŋ hanindapmaaŋ habene notneye hinek tiiŋ.

Tiŋa hidi nu mu nehikahilegiŋ, adi tobo nu hidi hehikahileeŋ kwanai gineŋ hapmewene wooŋ kwanai tubune folooŋ hinek minta hautaaŋ hali wooŋ halaak. Wendegoŋ tiŋa hehikahilegut. Unduŋ tiŋa hidi nemek niŋdok nadiŋa kaŋ nu wotnene gineŋ Baŋ ninadiune adi kedem hamuluwaak.
Nu yodoko medene indiŋ hanilat. Hidi hide uŋgoŋ welekubugoŋ tiŋa not momooŋ tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ.”
Jesudi mihiŋiye mede yeniŋkiliti tuguk
“Metamdi habuŋa guliniŋgoŋ tubune kaŋ indiŋ nadineeŋ, Wapumnik koom undugoŋ timiŋgiŋ.
Metam nadisukilitihinit mokit dut tomboyoula hatiyaneŋ binek adi not tihamaneŋ. Nu adi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineniŋ hanagile hidi titiŋhik u sigilulum timiŋgiŋ doktiŋa metamdi habuguliniŋgoŋ tiiŋ.

Mede indiŋ haniŋgut u naditomneeŋ, tipilapilaye-me adi wapumŋiŋ kalakapmeŋ mu tilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa metamdi nemek nutok tinamgiŋ u hiditok maaŋ tihamneeŋ. Adi mik tinamgiŋ kaŋ hidi maaŋ mik tihamneeŋ. Be nu’walaŋ mede nadidahi tigiŋ adi hidi’walaŋ mede maaŋ nadidahi tineeŋ.
Metam adi me napmeune fogut u mu kakiyondaiŋ doktiŋa nutok tiŋa unduŋ tihamneeŋ.
Nu adi kwetfoloŋ mu fooŋ mebi mu yodakalewe tugut adi metam kadakaniŋhinit mokit hatiyaneŋ. Iŋgoŋ agaŋ buŋa tugut doktiŋa metam mu nadinamiiŋ adi’walaŋ kadakaniŋhik adi hali wooŋ halaak.
Nebek niŋdi nu nabuŋa guliniŋgoŋ tilak adi Batne maaŋ undugoŋ kaŋ guliniŋgoŋ tilak.
Nu lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ Bepaŋ kunumneniŋ’walaŋ kudi mebimebi u mu tilit binek adi metam kadakaniŋhinit mokit hatiyaneŋ. Yoŋ adi agaŋ tubudapmawe kakabeleeŋ nu be Baŋ indi guliniŋgoŋ hogok tinimiiŋ.
Youkudip mede gineŋ mede niŋ indiŋ hatak u fafaŋelak, ‘Adi mebinit mokit guliniŋgoŋ u hogok-ku tinamfit tigiŋ.’
“Miŋ-ikilitihik u kamewe fooŋ nu’walaŋ mebine yohautawaak. Adi mede biyagoŋ diniŋ Munabuli, Baŋ dut hatilak.
Tiŋa hidi kwanai tububihikutneŋgoŋ nukut hatitabugiŋ doktiŋa hidi maaŋ mebine u youhautaneeŋ.”
